Prepared pronunciation references

Sentence references reproduce the actual Misaki American English phoneme input used for the 3000 Michael narration clips, including the 27 corrected sentence pronunciations. The compact notation is expanded into IPA; syllabic consonant notation is approximated with a schwa for readability. This is a phonetic reference, not a human-certified pronunciation grade.

Word references are regenerated from Misaki US gold/silver lexicons, with eSpeak fallback for missing forms. Heteronym variants are retained. Old dictionary IPA is not used as the comparison target. Misaki source: https://github.com/hexgrad/misaki/tree/fba1236595f2d2bf21d414ba6e57d25256afada3 . Misaki is Apache-2.0; see MISAKI-LICENSE.txt. The English/Korean dictionary word selection and meanings retain the attribution in data-credits.html.

Hama is used only to estimate phonemes heard in the learner recording, not to generate reference pronunciation or evaluate stress. Both observed differences and model errors are possible.
